fns.desc: sae_tests()'s FFC (group==15) branch calls sae_deinit_pt(pt) where pt is a mid-list node (pt_groups={19,20,21,25,26,28,29,30,15,0}), not the list head pt_info. sae_deinit_pt() only walks forward from the given node (src/common/sae.c:1282-1295, `while (pt) {...; pt = pt->next; os_free(prev);}`), so every earlier list node (groups 19,20,21,25,26,28,29,30) is leaked on this failure path.
Same partial-list-free leak as line 490, on the sibling failure branch (PT/PWE test-vector mismatch) of the FFC (group==15) case.
